name: LOLEUM TEMULENTUM
key_symptoms: Nausea, vomiting. Pain in pit of stomach and abdomen. Severe purging.
Anxious and depressed, confused. Vertigo; must close eyes. Head heavy. Noises in ears.

Gait unsteady. Trembling of all limbs. Loss of power in extremities. Violent pain in calves, as if bound with cords. Cold extremities. Spasmodic motions of arms and legs. Cannot write; cannot hold a glass of water. Trembling of hands in paralysis.
